working_definition: A practical editorial frame for noticing where AI-assisted work shifts attention, review burden, evidence needs, and human judgment.

mapped_dimensions.description: Can the reader see which sources shaped the narrative?
Are strong claims separated from supported internal framing?
Are quotation and publication-rights boundaries visible before publication?
Did a human editor approve the allowed use and limitations?

not_claimed: Attention Intelligence is not represented here as a clinically validated trait.
